data_description.scan_interval: Each poll is one request that the Systemair cloud relays to the unit. Default 60 s; below 30 s is not recommended. During testing, about 100 requests within a couple of minutes took the unit offline for a few minutes (it recovered on its own).
data_description.cloud_push: Only gives status updates (online, alarms, firmware update); settings and readings still come from polling.
